goals: Provide Silver Birch, Wisteria and Sweet Violets as separate Minecraft Java 26.2 Fabric content using supplied private textures.
Preserve target-version tree shapes and density while replacing old-growth birch materials and selecting 25% Wisteria in cherry groves.
scope: Native plank, timber, stripped and crafted wood identities alongside the existing tool-gated leaves, saplings, fuel, composting and decorations.
Loaded tree/fallen-tree material substitution preserves shape parameters and applicable decorators; biome-scoped selectors cover standing/fallen birch variants and weighted cherry/Wisteria attempts.

Preferred tree-associated Sweet Violets with a bounded successful-growth decorator; remove the independent grove petal pass; retain Nemo ordinary cherry and unrelated decorators without a required Nemo dependency.

Position-dependent compensated mustard-gold Silver Birch leaf tint with exact existing hue variation and saturation, a normal cube leaf item with one matching default tint, #B0C73A old-growth grass tint, separately namespaced Wisteria particles, and the standalone user-supplied Wisteria log-top texture.

Optional client Iris material-map fallback: only absent Silver Birch states inherit corresponding loaded vanilla Birch Leaves state assignments, while only absent Wisteria states continue inheriting matching vanilla Cherry Leaves state IDs; no shader-pack/profile edits or fake animation.

Client-only soil-dependent base bark on upright Silver Birch log sides, using the exact supplied packaged texture and extensible silver_birch_base_soils block tag; items use ordinary bark and both base-model ends use the namespaced owner sprite. Contextual geometry keys and resource/tag/neighbor rebuild handling preserve current placed trees without saved-state changes.

Native signs, shelves, boats and the full crafted families use dedicated identities. Mossy Oak supplies four timber forms with Ribbits-conditional plank recipes. Natural Swamp Oak and Fallen Oak use a one-third per-position roll, and the six Fancy Oak configurations use one tenth. Oak sapling growth uses those standing-tree rates only when its selected feature qualifies. Ordinary Oak retains native timber.

exclusions: No new biomes, independent Mossy Oak tree species, RU runtime dependency, CTM base-log block or bushy/drooping geometry.
No runtime deployment, slot changes, retrogen, existing-tree conversion, profile mutation or protected gameplay-instance access.
No redistribution of supplied restricted pixels, reference binaries or privately retained artifact.

dependencies.reason: Exact target for audited tree data and APIs.
Block, biome, content registry, creative-tab, client tint and particle APIs.
